gen-dafont-ozone-gf-fauna-one: Literary, dignified, with shallow ascenders and descenders, this serif reads like a quiet study beside Ozone. Fauna One opens the eye of its e generously, while the technical heading keeps stems and crossbars at a single thickness.
gen-dafont-ozone-gf-kadwa: Open-ended curves and a larger x-height give this serif a classic editorial voice, set against Ozone. Kadwa does the sustained reading, while Ozone, drawn like a single thread, does the quick announcing.
gen-dafont-ozone-gf-piazzolla: Authoritative, this serif has lowercase nearly matching its capitals and an e pried open like a clasp. Piazzolla would carry a whole article without tiring, while Ozone, cut like sign-shop vinyl, stays up top.
gen-dafont-ozone-switzer: Technical and geometric, Ozone draws stems and crossbars at a single thickness with wide-set curve ends. Switzer counters with tubular, wire-like letterforms and c tips that never creep toward touching, Swiss and approachable.
gen-dafont-plakkaat-gf-halant: Plakkaat swaps hairline joins for full-width strokes, so its heavy letters look like bent straw, closed and nearly self-touching. Halant brings the openness: tongs-shaped terminals and arches that thin slightly.
gen-dafont-plakkaat-gf-headland-one: Heavy, closed letters from Plakkaat set the weight. Headland One lightens that with dignified, open letters set well apart, gentle stroke variation and a rounded o nearly matching the capital.
gen-dafont-plakkaat-gf-noto-serif-hentai: Noto Serif Hentaigana is a refined, traditional serif with open jaws on every curve and small letters nearly capital height. Plakkaat, heavy and closed, gives it something solid to lean on.
gen-dafont-plakkaat-gf-ovo: Ovo is classic and authoritative, with thins only slightly lighter than its thicks and spacious gaps at curve terminals. Plakkaat has no stroke contrast at all to slow the eye, and its closed letters hit hard.
gen-dafont-quantum-gf-faustina: Loose and techy: Quantum gives every letter breathing room, while Faustina thins its bowls gracefully but not sharply. Quantum draws without tapering; Faustina shades each curve with subtle weight.
gen-dafont-quantum-gf-halant: Quantum has a smooth drawn-wire feel across the whole line, loose in its letterfit and short in its ascenders. Halant, an authoritative serif, brings stems a touch heavier than its crossbars.
